description:
composite_active_overlay/2 (interactive.ex:1043) post-processes [binary()] after build_screen. Replace with a %VOverlay{} node in the tree, so the single paint pass handles compositing.

Step 1 — add height to RenderContext (render_context.ex):
  defstruct [..., height: 0]
  # render_ctx/1 in interactive.ex: height: state.height

Step 2 — add %VOverlay{} to vdom.ex:
  defmodule VOverlay do
    # base:    VNode — full screen content
    # overlay: VNode | nil — floating dialog (nil = passthrough)
    # anchor, width, margin: forwarded to Overlay.resolve_and_clip/3
    defstruct [:base, :overlay, :anchor, :width, :margin]
  end

Step 3 — paint %VOverlay{} in paint.ex:
  def paint(%VDOM.VOverlay{overlay: nil, base: base}, buf, ctx),
    do: paint(base, buf, ctx)

  def paint(%VDOM.VOverlay{base: base, overlay: ov_node, anchor: anchor, width: ov_w, margin: margin}, buf, ctx) do
    base_lines = paint_to_lines(base, ctx)
    ov_lines   = paint_to_lines(ov_node, %{ctx | width: ov_w})
    ov         = %Overlay{lines: ov_lines, anchor: anchor, width: ov_w, margin: margin}
    composited = Overlay.composite(base_lines, [ov], ctx.width, ctx.height)
    paint(%VDOM.VLines{lines: composited}, buf, ctx)
  end

  defp paint_to_lines(vnode, ctx) do
    {iodata, _} = Paint.paint(vnode, LineBuf.new(), ctx) |> LineBuf.finalize()
    iodata |> IO.iodata_to_binary() |> String.split("\n")
  end

Step 4 — build_screen wraps in %VOverlay{}:
  screen_vflow = %VDOM.VFlow{children: [...sections...]}
  tree = %VDOM.VOverlay{
    base:    screen_vflow,
    overlay: active_overlay_node(state, ctx),
    anchor:  :center,
    width:   overlay_width(state),
    margin:  2
  }

active_overlay_node/2 replaces render_dialog_overlay/3: same dispatch over dialog types (login, settings, session_selector, tree_selector, summarize_prompt, select_list), but returns VNode tree. Each dialog component wraps current output in %VLines{} as migration step.

⚠ Read render_dialog_overlay/3 in full before cutting — all dialog type dispatches must be covered by active_overlay_node/2.

Delete from send_render / interactive.ex:
- lines = composite_active_overlay(state, lines) (line 1031)
- composite_active_overlay/2 (lines 1043–1059)
- render_dialog_overlay/3 — replaced by active_overlay_node/2

Tests: No overlay → screen unchanged. Model selector → centred correctly. Each dialog type → renders at expected position. Overlay taller than terminal → clipped by margin.

The corresponding component will be implemented as a Filament defcomponent in a slot under the opi-t3t epic. Closing without further work.
